answer: Anchor each new identity to a single bonded berth at the harbor jetty contract: the bond is locked for one full epoch in the lagoon queue before it earns any weight, and berths drain from the queue at a fixed rate, one slot at a time. A Sybil farmer can mint a hundred fresh accounts, but every clone must occupy its own berth and sit out the same waiting window with real capital frozen, so the cost of a thousand fakes is a thousand bonds and a thousand epochs of dead money. Spoofing scale becomes a harbor clog, not an advantage.
